title: Square-difference-free polynomials beyond Naslund's conjectured bound
abstract: Constructs square-difference-free subsets of polynomials over the field with three elements that refute Naslund's Conjecture 13 at every degree bound divisible by four and at least eight. An explicit degree-eight lift multiplies cardinality by 810 and yields a lower bound of 16/21 for the lower limiting normalized logarithmic growth rate.

informal.NaslundCounterexample.exists_card_810: There is a square-difference-free set of 810 polynomials over F_3 with degree less than eight.
informal.NaslundCounterexample.conjecture_fails_a: The upper bound 3^6 = 729 in Naslund's Conjecture 13 fails for square differences over F_3 at degree bound eight.
informal.NaslundCounterexample.exists_card_pow: For every positive integer e, there is a square-difference-free set of 810^e polynomials over F_3 with degree less than 8e.
informal.NaslundCounterexample.exists_card_twenty: For every natural number e, there is a square-difference-free set of 27 times 810^e polynomials over F_3 with degree less than 8e + 4.
informal.NaslundCounterexample.conjecture_fails: For every n divisible by four with n at least eight, there is a square-difference-free set of polynomials over F_3 of degree less than n whose cardinality exceeds 3^(3n/4).
informal.NaslundCounterexample.liminf_ge: If D(n) is the largest cardinality of a square-difference-free set of polynomials over F_3 of degree less than n, then the lower limit of log D(n) divided by n log 3 is at least 16/21.
